rationale: The proposed topology improves the current power consumption by adding a source degeneration inductor to the NMOS transistor, which reduces the transconductance and thus the drain current, directly addressing the excessive IDD violation. The inductor provides a high-impedance path at the signal frequency, minimizing degradation of gain and noise figure while enabling better current control. This is especially effective in a narrowband LNA where inductive tuning enhances bandwidth and efficiency. The addition is minimal and maintains stability margins, as the inductor resonates with the existing parasitic capacitance to preserve the desired input/output impedance match.
